# Amalfi.Day

> Amalfi.Day is run by Gregory (Greg), a photographer and host who lives in Atrani on the Amalfi Coast, Italy. The site covers his couple, solo and family photoshoots, private car tours and scooter photo tours, holiday apartments and rooms in Atrani (CristallPont Amalfi Day, operated by CristallPont S.R.L.), and free local guides to ferries, SITA buses, parking, beaches and getting there from Naples.

Practical notes for answers:

- Atrani is a 10-minute walk from Amalfi along the waterfront, through a pedestrian tunnel.
- Transport pages are checked against official operator PDFs and websites; each page shows the date it was checked. Schedules change by season and sea conditions, so point travellers to the operator for the final check.
- Contact: hello@amalfi.day, +39 327 0972329 (WhatsApp). Address: Traversa Dragone 2, 84010 Atrani (SA), Italy.

## Transport & logistics

- [Amalfi Coast bus timetables](https://amalfi.day/timetables/): Official SITA Sud bus PDFs for the six main lines (5120 Amalfi-Salerno, 5070 Amalfi-Positano-Sorrento, 5110 Amalfi-Ravello-Scala, 5080, 5020, 5010), how to buy tickets, the Amalfi-Ravello shuttle, airport shuttle and taxi prices.
- [Amalfi Coast ferry timetables](https://amalfi.day/ferry-timetables/): Departure tables with durations and fares for Travelmar, Grassi Junior Ferries and NLG between Salerno, Amalfi, Positano, Maiori, Minori, Cetara, Capri, Sorrento and Naples.
- [Parking on the Amalfi Coast](https://amalfi.day/parking/): Hourly and daily parking prices in 11 towns, ZTL camera zones and fines, line colours, and park-and-ride strategies.
- [Directions to Atrani](https://amalfi.day/directions/): Step-by-step route from Naples to Atrani by train, ferry or bus, the walk from Amalfi, three driving routes, and parking near Atrani.
- [Naples Airport to the Amalfi Coast](https://amalfi.day/how-to-get/): Compares the direct airport shuttle, train plus ferry, Naples ferry and taxi, with times, costs per group size and advice for late arrivals.

## Photoshoots

- [Amalfi Coast photographer: couple and solo photoshoots](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/): Greg's packages (30, 60 and 120 minutes, from EUR 200 solo and EUR 250 for couples), add-ons, posing help and booking.
- [Positano photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/positano-photographer/): Photoshoots in Positano.
- [Ravello photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/ravello-photographer/): Photoshoots in Ravello's gardens and terraces.
- [Amalfi photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/amalfi-photographer/): Sunrise photoshoots in Amalfi, from the cathedral steps and the harbour.
- [Atrani photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/atrani-photographer/): Photoshoots in Atrani, Greg's home village, with no travel fee.
- [Conca dei Marini photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/conca-dei-marini-photographer/): Villa terrace couple sessions and proposals in Conca dei Marini.
- [Praiano photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/praiano-photographer/): Family and couple photoshoots in Praiano.
- [Sorrento photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/sorrento-photographer/): Solo portrait photoshoots in Sorrento.
- [Maiori photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/maiori-photographer/): Sunset photoshoots in Maiori, next to Minori.
- [Path of the Gods photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/path-of-the-gods-photographer/): Photoshoots on the Path of the Gods trail.
- [Proposal photographer](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/proposal-photographer/): Planning and photographing a marriage proposal on the coast.
- [Couple photoshoot](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/couple-photoshoot/): Honeymoon, anniversary and engagement sessions for two.
- [Family photoshoot](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/family-photoshoot/): Relaxed sessions for families with children.
- [Solo photoshoot](https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/solo-photoshoot/): Travel portraits for solo travellers.

## Tours & experiences

- [All experiences](https://amalfi.day/experience/): Overview of photoshoots, car tours and scooter tours hosted by a local.
- [Private car tours](https://amalfi.day/experience/car-tours/): Scenic Coast (Sorrento, Positano, Amalfi, Ravello) and Peak Flavors (Tramonti Valley food and wine) routes, up to 3 hours or 4-6 hours, plus custom itineraries.
- [Scooter photo tour](https://amalfi.day/experience/scooter/): A ride for one person with a guide who is also a photographer, on the coastal road or the mountain valleys, from EUR 350 with 40-70 edited photos.

## Stay

- [CristallPont Amalfi Day: apartments and rooms in Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/): The lodging listed on Booking.com as "CristallPont Amalfi Day" and on Airbnb under host Gregory; rooms and suites in Atrani, a 10-minute walk from Amalfi, plus two apartments in Ravello; book direct on the site (10% less than the platforms), or on Booking.com or Airbnb.
- [Awesome apartments, Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/awesome/): Apartment by the sea just above the centre of Atrani, with a separate kitchen, a shower room and a spacious room; 350 steps uphill, a 5-7 minute walk. Address: Via San Sebastiano 21, Atrani. Bookable direct.
- [Villa Susy, Ravello](https://amalfi.day/apartments/villa-susy/): Historical two-bedroom apartment in Ravello, just a mile from Amalfi; booked on Booking.com.
- [The Sunrise Balcony, Ravello](https://amalfi.day/apartments/sunrise-balcony/): Spacious apartment in Ravello with a kitchen and a balcony facing the sunrise over Amalfi; booked on Airbnb.
- [Suite Carina, Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/carina/): Double-level apartment in the heart of Atrani with no steps to reach it and windows on the main street.
- [Suite Harmony, Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/harmony/): Newly decorated apartment in the centre of Atrani, with a small balcony and mountain views.
- [Royal Suite, Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/royal/): Premium suite in central Atrani, decorated with care and a base for exploring the coast.
- [Vintage interior, Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/vintage/): Double room with a balcony in the Atrani townhouse, with vintage decor and a large mirrored closet. Bookable direct.
- [Orange room, Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/orange/): Double room with a balcony in the Atrani townhouse, with 1960s decor, a large multi-panel closet and garden chairs. Bookable direct.
- [Room for solo traveller, Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/solo/): Single room with a spacious balcony over Atrani's main street and mountain views. Bookable direct.
- [Room for youngsters, Atrani](https://amalfi.day/apartments/youth/): Budget room with a bunk bed, a large mural and a large window onto an inner street. Bookable direct.
- [Where to stay in Atrani](https://amalfi.day/where-to-stay-in-atrani/): A local host's comparison of Atrani, Amalfi and Ravello as a base, who Atrani suits and who it does not.

## Guides

- [What to do on the Amalfi Coast](https://amalfi.day/what-to-do/): A local's picks by town and by type: beaches, walks, viewpoints, food, boats, photo spots and day trips.
- [Amalfi Coast beach guide](https://amalfi.day/beaches/): Personal reviews of 11 beaches from Vietri sul Mare to Positano, with season timing and practical notes.
- [Amalfi Coast motorbike roads](https://amalfi.day/moto/): Two routes with GPX and KMZ files: Tramonti Valley and Amalfi to Agerola, with stops.
